method: Each completed chunk's producer and consumer reports were read offline; their complete legs-object SHA256 identities matched the immutable ledger. The public records below allowlist aliases, payload counts, payload digests and timestamps only.
digestScope: Individual chunk payload, not a digest of the concatenated 100 GB leg. Repeated deterministic chunk contents intentionally repeat digests.
canonicalEncoding: UTF-8 JSON, sorted object keys, separators comma/colon, no whitespace or trailing newline, applied to records array.
